fixes.change: New apps/api/src/lib/auth-cache.ts: cache keyed on SHA-256 of the WHOLE token, so an entry can only be read back by the exact token that produced it and a forged token hashes elsewhere. fixes.change: ensure-schema.ts:578 SCHEMA_INVARIANTS_FINGERPRINT = sha256 of the statement array; :637 one SELECT against a `_schema_invariants` marker short-circuits the whole replay when it matches. fixes.change: cache.ts:60-105 adds a bounded in-process store (1,000 entries, LRU-by-recency eviction, per-key TTL) used only when no Redis client exists — Redis still wins outright when REDIS_URL is set and the memory store is not consulted at all.
